criteria_evaluated.evidence_chain: Every stage writes JSON proof and dashboard status.
failure_modes: Hermes/Codex gate not available or not passed
criteria_evaluated.falsifiability: Each PASS must have explicit FAIL conditions.
criteria_evaluated.measurability: Each step must output paths, statuses, hashes or gate results.
criteria_evaluated.minimal_scope: Only assignment loop surfaces and dashboard pointers are in scope before execution.
criteria_evaluated.testability: Every proposed build artifact must have a deterministic read/check proof.

truth_boundary: Scientific quality gate only. No assignment/build/patch execution.
